deploy.startCommand: sh -c 'echo "[boot] PORT=${PORT:-unset}, binding 3000 to match the domain target port"; ( npx prisma migrate deploy && echo "[migrate] applied" || ( echo "[migrate] retrying after an interrupted migration"; npx prisma migrate resolve --rolled-back 20260801000000_init; npx prisma migrate deploy && echo "[migrate] applied on retry" || echo "[migrate] FAILED" ) ) & exec npx next start -H 0.0.0.0 -p 3000'
